scope: Exploratory single-valid-run comparison; real Main and Jev; mock SubAgent execution and existing-task state; no real task-completion evaluation or Jev failover.

source_provenance.note: Measurements used a working tree with uncommitted Runtime changes. Their patch was not frozen with this experiment; a clean checkout can rerun the harness but is not the exact measured Runtime snapshot.

measurement_contract.first_reply_ms: First successful visible delivery since ingress; null when none.
measurement_contract.final_reply_ms: Legacy field name for LAST successful visible delivery, not semantic completion.
measurement_contract.first_model_response_ms: Completion of the first Main model call, including tool-call decisions.
measurement_contract.total_tokens: Sum of actual Main provider total_tokens and Jev input/output tokens; mock child tokens are zero. Cached input and reasoning tokens are included, not added twice. No monetary cost claim.
measurement_contract.percentiles: Nearest rank within the case group, not repeated measurements of one case.
measurement_contract.reply_review: Assistant inspection of visible responses, not an independent semantic Judge or production defect verdict.

confounders: B has an additional Runtime routing responsibility prompt; the original Base routing prompt was retained. Dynamic clock text also differs.
Chat delivery rates differ: A 4/10 and B 8/10. Extra send_text follow-up model calls confound full-run chat token comparisons.
